inlines.v: CELESTIAL, adjective 1. Heavenly; belonging or relating to heaven; dwelling in heaven; as celestial spirits; celestial joys. Hence the word conveys the idea of superior excellence, delight, purity, etc. 2. Belonging to the upper regions, or visible heaven; as celestial signs; the celestial globe. 3. Descending from heaven; as a suit of celestial armor. CELESTIAL, noun An inhabitant of heaven.
